system.description:
Looks at who a subject is and what in their past brought them here: background events, qualities, goals, motivations, virtues, vices and relationships.

Spell. Flash of Insight. A quick, subtle reading of who someone is now; only sorcerers trained in the same Method notice it.

Ritual. Alignment: Reading the Spirit: Challenging (9) Awareness, 10 minutes. Invocation: Formidable (12) Knowledge, one hour. Unleashing: Challenging (9) Will. Degrees from Invocation and Unleashing become Insights and Insight Dice about the subject.

Art of Divination — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 99.
